A '''nanowave stove'''<ref name="ZHR">''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]''</ref> or '''nano-wave cooker'''<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref> was a type of stove used to heat and cook [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]].<ref name="ZHR" /> [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] owned such a machine at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|his diner]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DD">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>
